# GitHub Copilot Instructions for Gestão3D

- Follow strict TypeScript 5 guidelines with explicit interface definitions in `/src/legacy-app/types.ts` or `/src/market3d/types.ts`.
- Prefer React 19 functional components and hooks (`useState`, `useMemo`, `useCallback`, `useEffect`).
- Follow Tailwind CSS v4 styling rules.
- Maintain WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility features (`aria-*` attributes, keyboard navigation support, high-contrast focus rings).
